 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Dr. Justice K.Manmadha Rao
 Oral Judgment

This appeal has been filed by the claimant challenging the impugned judgment and award dated 19.10.2016 passed by the Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal and Principal Senior Civil Judge, Udupi (for short 'the Tribunal'), in M.V.C.No.869/2013.

The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.8,22,070/- together with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till the date of actual deposit, towards the injuries sustained by the claimant- appellant in a road traffic accident that occurred on 17.11.2012.
NC: 2026:KHC:13164 HC-KAR 2.
Though the matter is listed for orders, with the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the matter is taken up for final disposal.
3. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant as well as the learned counsel for respondent-Insurance company.
Perused the impugned judgment and award passed by the Tribunal and the material on record.

4. Having regard to the nature of the injuries suffered by the appellant-claimant, I am of the opinion that it would be appropriate to award an additional sum of Rs.75,000/- inclusive of interest by way of global compensation.

5. Hence, I pass the following order:-

sentences.text: (i) The appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The impugned judgment and award dated 19.10.2016 passed by the Tribunal is modified by awarding an additional sum of Rs.75,000/- inclusive of interest.
However, in view of the order dated 04.03.2026, NC: 2026:KHC:13164 HC-KAR the appellant-claimant would not be entitled for the interest for the delayed period of 1212 days in filing the appeal.
(iii) The aforesaid enhanced compensation amount of Rs.75,000/- shall be deposited within a period of eight weeks from today by the Insurance company before the Tribunal.
(iv) Amount in deposit with accrued interest, if any, shall be transmitted to the Tribunal.
(iv) Registry is directed to send back the TCR to the Tribunal.

SD/-
